player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Mafuta Ashilu - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kulemba cha maliji chize kuchishi. Zachisa: A:5 B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Jina lia munda wa uhenge ((s)). Munda mulemu: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: All allocations must be non-negative integers.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Onga kwiza kufika {num_total_units} ngolo. Jumla iliyopo: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ashila {score_0}-{score_1} baada ya {num_rounds} mafuta!
outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta ashila {score_1}-{score_0} baada ya {num_rounds} mafuta!
outcome.draw: Game ends in a {score_0}-{score_1} tie after {num_rounds} rounds!
outcome.early_winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ashila {scores_0}-{scores_1} (kutwala kwa wingi kilifikia)!
outcome.early_winner_beta: Commander Beta ashila {scores_1}-{scores_0} (kutwala kwa wingi kilifikia)!
